issue_context.summary: The update progress bar reportedly disappears when navigating away from General during an update.
known_information: Report version is 0.0.0 and does not identify a usable build.
Screenshots show progress before and after navigating between Settings tabs.
Current UpdateViewModel derives UI state from active update operation and current update settings.
inferences: If it persists, a tab transition may detach the progress binding while the operation continues; current-release behavior is unknown.
issue_context.analysis: Current source tracks active update state, so the old report alone does not establish a current defect. Determine whether the operation continues while only the bar disappears.
initial_investigation: UpdateViewModel.CurrentUpdateUIState is computed from updating settings and active operation: src/settings-ui/Settings.UI/ViewModels/UpdateViewModel.cs.

information_gaps.information: Whether progress still disappears on current release and whether download/install continues while it is absent.
information_gaps.why_needed: This distinguishes a presentation binding problem from the update operation stopping or old behavior already being fixed.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: Start an available update, switch away from General during progress, then report current version, visible progress, and whether update continued.

comment.body: The screenshots show progress before changing Settings tabs, but the report’s version is 0.0.0 and does not establish current behavior. Current Settings code tracks an active update operation, so the key distinction is whether the operation continues while only the bar disappears. Please test once on current PowerToys: switch away from General during an update, then report whether download/install continues and what the bar shows when you return.
